campaign.title: Dr. Michele Cantwell-Copher For Fresno County Superintendent of Schools
campaign.retrieval: Direct captured campaign HTML; Qwen proposal and Jev source review

before.scope_note: Policy statements on captured campaign pages; not an exhaustive search for all candidate positions.

pages.title: Dr. Michele Cantwell-Copher For Fresno County Superintendent of Schools
Leadership - Dr. Copher for Fresno County Superintendent of Schools
Leadership - Dr. Copher for Fresno County Superintendent of Schools

points.summary: Every child in Fresno County should have the chance to succeed from preschool through first job
points.quote: I believe every child in Fresno County deserves the chance to succeed, from their first day of preschool through their first day on the job.

points.summary: Commitment to strong literacy, math instruction, safe campuses, and college/career pathways
points.quote: That means strong literacy and math instruction, safe campuses, real pathways to college and career

points.summary: Cantwell-Copher commits to expanding early childhood education access and strengthening literacy, mathematics, and STEM achievement.
points.quote: We will expand access to high-quality early childhood education, strengthen literacy, mathematics, and STEM achievement

points.summary: Cantwell-Copher states that partnerships with law enforcement ensure children are physically and psychologically safe in Fresno County schools.
points.quote: Through strong partnerships with law enforcement, parents can be assured that children are both physically and psychologically safe in Fresno County schools.

points.summary: Cantwell-Copher commits to increasing A-G course offerings, dual enrollment, and career technical education programs for all students.
points.quote: We will continue increasing A-G course offerings, dual enrollment opportunities, and career technical education programs

points.summary: Cantwell-Copher states as a core belief that schools should be fiscally responsible and deliver on promises to the public and students.
points.quote: Our schools should be fiscally responsible and deliver on promises- our public and our students deserve that.

points.summary: Cantwell-Copher commits to strengthening literacy, mathematics, and STEM achievement for students.
points.quote: strengthen literacy, mathematics, and STEM achievement

points.summary: Cantwell-Copher asserts schools should be fiscally responsible and deliver on promises to the public and students.
points.quote: Our schools should be fiscally responsible and deliver on promises
